Press and let go for a single button, hold a button and press another for a combo. = 按下後放開為單一按鍵；按住一個按鍵再按另一個為組合鍵。

; Presets
Preset loaded: {0} = 已載入預設組：{0}
Delete = 刪除
Confirm delete = 確認刪除
cannot read {0} = 無法讀取 {0}
cannot delete {0} = 無法刪除 {0}
Preset: {0} = 預設組：{0}
Every bind change is saved into the active preset. Click a preset to switch to it. = 所有綁定變更都會存入目前的預設組。點選預設組即可切換。
New preset: name, then Enter = 新預設組：輸入名稱後按 Enter
A new preset starts as a copy of the current binds. = 新預設組會以目前的綁定為起點。
Preset created: {0} = 已建立預設組：{0}
The only preset can't be deleted. = 無法刪除唯一的預設組。
Double tap = 連按兩下
Hold = 長按
The bind works on a quick double press. A single press still does what it did, a moment later. = 快速連按兩下時觸發此綁定。單按一下仍執行原本的動作，只是稍晚一些。
The bind works when the button is held down for a moment. A short press still does what it did. = 按住按鍵片刻時觸發此綁定。短按仍執行原本的動作。
{0} (double tap) = {0}（連按兩下）
{0} (hold) = {0}（長按）
{0} takes a single key or mouse button only: no Shift / Ctrl / Alt, combos, gamepad, double tap or hold. = {0} 只接受單一按鍵或滑鼠按鈕：不支援 Shift / Ctrl / Alt、組合鍵、手把、連按兩下或長按。
Rebind failed: {0} = 重新綁定失敗：{0}
Saved into {0}'s own settings file ({1}), {0} picks it up at once. A single key or mouse button only. = 儲存到 {0} 自己的設定檔（{1}），{0} 會立即套用。只限單一按鍵或滑鼠按鈕。
this key can't be written there = 此按鍵無法寫入該處
{0} not found in {1} = 在 {1} 中找不到 {0}
Press the new key or mouse button for: {0} ({1}) = 請按下新的按鍵或滑鼠按鈕：{0}（{1}）
A single key or mouse button: {0} doesn't support combos, Shift / Ctrl / Alt, the gamepad, double tap or hold. = 單一按鍵或滑鼠按鈕：{0} 不支援組合鍵、Shift / Ctrl / Alt、手把、連按兩下或長按。
{0} has no key for this yet. Set one in its own settings menu (MCM, dMenu); after that it can be changed here too. = {0} 尚未為此設定按鍵。請先在它自己的設定選單（MCM、dMenu）中設定，之後也可以在這裡更改。
ENB keys can't be changed here. Change them in ENB's own menu or in enblocal.ini ([INPUT]) in the game folder. = 無法在這裡更改 ENB 的按鍵。請在 ENB 自己的選單中，或在遊戲資料夾的 enblocal.ini（[INPUT]）中更改。
{0} reads the keyboard itself, not through the game, so Hotkey Atlas can't move its keys. Change them in its own settings: {1}. = {0} 自行讀取鍵盤，而非透過遊戲，因此 Hotkey Atlas 無法移動它的按鍵。請在它自己的設定中更改：{1}。
Button taken = 按鈕已被佔用
{0} in {1} is already used by: {2}. = {0} 在 {1} 中已被使用於：{2}。
In one context the game runs only one action per button, the other would stop working. = 在同一情境中，遊戲每個按鈕只會執行一個動作，另一個將失效。
Swap: {0} goes on {1}, {2} goes on {3}. = 交換：{0} 改用 {1}，{2} 改用 {3}。
{0} can't go on {1}, so the buttons can't be swapped. = {0} 無法改用 {1}，因此無法交換按鈕。
Swap = 交換
Swapped: {0} and {1} traded buttons in {2}. = 已交換：{0} 與 {1} 在 {2} 中互換了按鈕。
